description: Rename a field, add select options, or edit and remove existing ones. Returns the updated field. Editing is non-destructive: recolouring or renaming an option leaves every record that holds it untouched, because options have stable ids and records point at the id, not the text. Removing one is the exception — it refuses with a usage count unless you confirm, and can reassign holders to another option.

add_options.description: New choices to add to a select/multi_select/workflow field. A workflow option's state category is inferred from its label unless you give one.

category.description: State category: backlog | unstarted | started | completed | canceled (completed and canceled mean finished). Workflow options only (and select options that say it); inferred from the label when omitted on a workflow.

icon.description: Curated icon ref: "set:<name>" or "brand:<slug>" (See also: get_started section "ICONS").

field.description: Field to update (name, api_name, or id).

remove_options.description: Delete options. Refuses with a usage count unless confirmed; the count is what confirming accepts.

confirm.description: Required when records still use it. Without it you get a refusal naming the count.

option.description: Existing option, by label or id.

reassign_to.description: Move holders onto this option instead of clearing them.

unique.description: #229 — mark a text/number field Unique (rejects a duplicate value on create/edit) or turn it off. Turning it on scans existing records first and refuses (naming the conflicting ones) instead of silently enabling.

unique_normalize.description: With `unique: true` — fold case and trim whitespace before comparing (default true).

update_options.description: Recolour, rename or re-categorise EXISTING options. Records keep their values — ids are stable.

category.description: State category: backlog | unstarted | started | completed | canceled (completed and canceled mean finished). Workflow options only (and select options that say it); inferred from the label when omitted on a workflow. Pass null to clear it on a select option (a workflow option always keeps one).

color.description: New colour, from the option palette.

icon.description: Curated icon ref, or null to clear.

option.description: Existing option, by label or id.

name: update_field
title: Update field
